title: AI Agent Developer & Automation Engineer
systemName: Your technician outreach and order operations

facts: Original post retained in jd.txt; Upwork job ID 2112195798820744982, saved 2026-10-19.
The post requests AI agents for technician outreach, calls and emails, order intake, data entry and reporting, with a documented solution the client can manage independently.
The post names Python and/or JavaScript, LLM APIs, and workflow tools such as n8n or Make. n8n is the proposed demonstration tool, not an existing client system.
No client first name, operating industry, CRM, telephony provider, email provider, order API, field map or existing endpoints are supplied. Do not infer them from unrelated client work history.

All contacts, order details, events, counts and results are invented illustrative fixtures. Completed sample actions are depicted outcomes, not actual calls, emails or account writes. The workbench is a custom project workspace. HTTP Request integration actions are conceptual; no actual provider endpoint or authentication is claimed.
The original post requests pricing, timeline and relevant examples. No rates or delivery promises belong in this demo. Its proof is the visible illustrative sample, not past-project delivery.
